facts.activity_file: identifying every energy source for a task

control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of kinetic energy at P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3222 and M-3222 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically identifying every energy source for a task. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 2 January 2019 a potential incident was recorded on P-3222 and M-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
